summary: Russian Shahed and Geran drones strike across multiple Ukrainian regions while crossing into Polish airspace, with a guided Shahed hitting Dniprovskyi district of Kiev and a Geran-4/5 striking a passenger train locomotive 2km from the Polish border. Ukrainian GUR long-range drones hit the Slavyanovsk-ECO refinery in Kuban and energy infrastructure in Kursk region. 13 killed and 95 wounded in 24 hours of Russian attacks across Ukraine.
key_points: Russian forces advanced near Mykolaivka and Dovha Balka; Ukrainian counterattacks thwarted Russian breakthroughs toward Dnipropetrovsk and retook Kupiansk positions (Source: @DeepStateUA/23829, @UkraineNow/84077).
Geran-4/5 struck a passenger train locomotive 2km from the Polish border; another rocket-drone entered Polish airspace (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74449, @mon1tor_ua/74447).
At least 13 killed and 95 wounded in 24 hours from Russian attacks across Ukraine (Source: @UkraineNow/84069).
Guided Shahed drone struck Dniprovskyi district of Kiev; Shahed also hit Lutsk railway station (Source: @mon1tor_ua/74432, @UkraineNow/84065).
Ukrainian GUR drones struck Slavyanovsk-ECO oil refinery in Kuban, damaging key processing unit and reservoir park (Source: @UkraineNow/84074, @eRadarrua/113106).
Strike on Kursk region energy infrastructure, likely 330kV substation, caused significant damage (Source: @eRadarrua/113120).
Russian Geran drones hit logistics centers in Mykolaiv; Flamingo missiles struck chemical plant in Volgograd (Source: @tass_agency/395164, @UkraineNow/84078).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian drone and missile strikes are intensifying across multiple Ukrainian fronts simultaneously, with Shahed swarms originating from Sumy, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Khmelnytskyi, and Black Sea regions converging on numerous targets. Cross-border strikes into Poland (Geran-4/5 hitting a train 2km from border, rocket-drones entering Polish airspace) risk NATO Article 5 implications. Ukrainian GUR long-range strikes on Russian refinery infrastructure in Kuban and Kursk energy assets demonstrate expanding deep-strike capability. The combined effect stretches Ukrainian air defenses thin across a vast front from Zakarpattia to Odessa.
sections.regional_response: Poland faces direct escalation as Russian drones cross its border, likely triggering diplomatic consultations within NATO. Vilnius airport closure and reopening indicates Baltic states are also on high alert. Kushner's public statement that Ukraine must retreat to Kremlin-designated lines for peace suggests shifting Western diplomatic pressure. Zelensky's reported expectation of a Putin meeting at G20 Miami in December indicates continued diplomatic engagement despite on-ground escalation.
sections.intelligence_notes: The volume and multi-axis nature of Shahed launches (30+ tracked across multiple routes simultaneously) suggests a coordinated large-scale strike campaign. Russian forces consolidated control of Chernyakov in Kharkiv region while advancing near Mykolaivka and Dovha Balka. Ukrainian deep-strike success against Slavyanovsk-ECO refinery and Kursk energy infrastructure indicates effective GUR operational planning. The simultaneous Polish border incursions and domestic attacks suggest Russia is pursuing a dual-track strategy of military pressure and political coercion.
